item.text:
Please provide:

- Machine OS/version and whether it uses systemd, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.
- Exact service name and what it is supposed to do.
- How it is started and the exact error output.
- Current service status and relevant logs, pasted as text.
- When it last worked and what changed since then: config, package updates, certificates, permissions, dependencies, ports, or reboots.
- Whether other related services are affected.
- Any troubleshooting already attempted.
- Whether this is production and any restrictions on restarts or configuration changes.

Please redact passwords, tokens, private keys, and sensitive host details. I won’t access or change anything unless you explicitly ask me to.
